import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('joint_states.csv')
df['time'] = pd.to_datetime(df['timestamp'], unit='s')
df = df.set_index('time')
df['vel_j1'] = df['pos_j1'].diff() /
df.index.to_series().diff().dt.total_seconds()
df['vel_j1_filt'] = df['vel_j1'].rolling('50ms').mean()
summary = df[['pos_j1','pos_j2']].describe()
print(summary)
df.to_csv('cleaned_joints.csv')
